target_buyers.name: Ashtabula County Data Board / IT Services
target_buyers.fit_rationale: Primary technology decision-maker for Ashtabula County. The Data Board oversees all IT purchases, software, and services for county offices. Recent procurements include $75K for Citizenserve building software and court computer upgrades. They manage IT infrastructure for 25+ county departments.

target_buyers.name: InfinIT
target_buyers.fit_rationale: Northeast Ohio IT provider with 35+ years specializing in municipal government. Offers managed IT, VoIP, SD-WAN, cybersecurity, and cloud solutions specifically for local governments. CJIS-compliant for police departments. Already serves municipalities in the region. Potential partner for GovTech Box integration or white-label deployment.

contact_info.address: 1801 St Clair Ave NE, Cleveland, OH 44114 (Cleveland Office); 4195 Parkman Rd NW, Warren, OH 44481 (Warren-Youngstown Office)

target_buyers.decision_making_power: Medium - Can influence municipal technology decisions as trusted advisor

additional_prospects.name: Citizenserve
additional_prospects.fit_rationale: Ashtabula County Building Department signed a $75,000 3-year contract (Feb 2025) for Citizenserve's cloud-based permitting and licensing software. Represents active procurement of municipal software in the county—potential partner or benchmark for GovTech Box.

additional_prospects.name: VC3
additional_prospects.fit_rationale: Specializes in local government IT services across Ohio. Provides managed IT, 24/7 support, and strategic planning for municipalities. Police, fire, water/sewer departments are key clients. Has presence in multiple Ohio cities including Defiance, Independence, and Blue Ash.

contact_info.headquarters: Columbia, SC (Lebanon, OH office at 777 Columbus Avenue)

additional_prospects.name: Granicus
additional_prospects.fit_rationale: Global leader in government customer engagement technology. Ashtabula County already uses Granicus (confirmed via technology stack analysis). Powers 30B+ digital interactions annually. Connects 500,000+ government professionals. Ideal integration partner or competitive benchmark.

outreach_recommendations.priority_1: Contact Rockford Benson (CIO) at Ashtabula County - highest decision-making authority for IT procurements. Email: rbenson@ashtabulacounty.us (inferred).
outreach_recommendations.priority_2: Contact Scott Yamamoto (County Auditor) - oversees Data Board operations as secretary. Email: skyamamoto@ashtabulacounty.us.
outreach_recommendations.priority_3: Contact InfinIT Sales (sales@infinit.us) for partnership discussions - they have existing municipal relationships.
outreach_recommendations.outreach_angle: Reference the recent $75K Citizenserve procurement to demonstrate awareness of county's active technology investments. Position GovTech Box as complementary solution for other municipal departments.
